page.overview:
Who is Armed Dragon LV7?

Armed Dragon LV7 is a character version of the card, "Armed Dragon LV7".

Armed Dragon LV7 appears in the video games, Yu-Gi-Oh! Ultimate Masters: World Championship 2006 and Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. In World Championship 2006, it appears as a Limited Duelist and it challenges the player to only included Dragon-Type monsters in the Deck. In World Championship 2007, it appears as a Level Three Theme Duelist and it challenges the player to Tribute Summon 10 or more monsters during a duel. By beating it, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Four Theme Duelists and a new Booster Pack.

In World Championship 2006 and 2007, Armed Dragon LV7 plays a Dragon Deck titled, "Dragon's Lair" and "King of Summons".
